:::{#sol-projection-practice}

Split $(4, 3)$ as $(a, 0) + c\,(1, 1) = (a + c, c)$.
The second entry gives $c = 3$,
and then the first gives $a = 1$.
So $(4, 3) = (1, 0) + (3, 3)$,
with $(1, 0) \in \mathcal{S}$ and $(3, 3) \in \mathcal{T}$,
and the [projection of $\vecf{y}$ onto $\mathcal{S}$ along $\mathcal{T}$](#def-projection) is $(1, 0)$.

:::
